kids.name: words
kids.chars: The deepest book tier isn't available here.

node.name: footer · data statement
node.chars: Data: synthetic only — a seeded BTCUSDT book (seed 440): tick 0.10 and qty step 0.001 from the recorded instrument fixture; mark 64,012.5; 500 levels a side with seeded gaps; rows at a 10 USDT zoom; 60 trail columns of 1 s to 00:12:19 UTC; sizes, walls, prints, stops, the own orders and position, the accounts "Acct A" and "Acct B" and the viewing-as user "Manager 01" are synthetic. No real account identifier, key or balance. The env badge reads the session environment (DEMO on this board), never the feed (C-2.11).

kids.chars: §0 L101: §3 tier strip 50 / 200 / 500; SCR-050/500-unavailable (the option T2); the tier notice

kids.name: value-2

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: Frames 1280 × 800 windows at compact density unless the frame says otherwise; BTCUSDT on a seeded synthetic book (§0)

kids.name: value-1

value-2.chars: The 500 option stays in the open listbox, arrow-reachable, rendering 2a under the option: aria-disabled, never disabled; CMP-079 + the CMP-019 lock; W-3 on the PROPOSED key book.tier_unavailable (owner E09-D09 #192, A-4)

value-3.chars: Enter on 500 changes nothing and re-shows W-3; a server refusal of a tier change is T4 at the point of action, not this frame (§3.2)

kit choice: the heatmap pane draws one row per ladder row (R-2) and one column per trail second (the cell chip's auto = 1 s), equal-stop runs drawn as one rect; compact and comfortable cells keep a 1 px gutter top and bottom, the cosy (`dense`) pane none (§3.1 'the pane's gutters tighter')
kit choice: CMP-230's glyph (second, after the text) drawn as an 8 px square in color.buy.default or color.sell.default; the words carry the side
kit choice: the pulled mark's hatch (pattern.hatch.estimated's look, D05E11 §7, cited not re-made) drawn as 2 × 2 steps of color.text.primary on a 6 px 45° track over the pulled cell
kit choice: board markers (focus-order numbers, announcements, accessible names, redline callouts) are drawn in a 1 px color.border.strong outline — not product UI
kit choice: menus and the open listbox drawn as color.surface.overlay cards with a 1 px color.border.default outline (popovers over the rows)
